type Shape = { kind: 'square'; side: number } | { kind: 'circle'; radius: number };

function withBreak(u: 'a' | 'b'): string {
  switch (u) {
    case 'a':
      return 'A';
    case 'b':
      break;
  }
  const rest: never = u;
  return rest;
}

function objectWithBreak(shape: Shape): number {
  switch (shape.kind) {
    case 'square':
      return shape.side;
    case 'circle':
      break;
  }
  const rest: never = shape;
  return rest;
}

function withDefault(u: 'a' | 'b'): string {
  switch (u) {
    case 'a':
      return 'A';
    default:
      return 'B';
  }
  const rest: never = u;
  return rest;
}

function neverMember(u: 'a' | 'b'): string {
  switch (u) {
    case 'a':
      return 'A';
    case 'b':
      return 'B';
  }
  return u.toUpperCase();
}

function assignedAfter(u: 'a' | 'b'): string {
  let q: string | number = 1;
  switch (u) {
    case 'a':
      return 'A';
    case 'b':
      return 'B';
  }
  q = 'k';
  const text: string = q;
  return text;
}

function mergedAfter(u: 'a' | 'b', q: string | number): string {
  if (typeof q === 'string') {
    switch (u) {
      case 'a':
        return 'A';
      case 'b':
        return 'B';
    }
    const rest: never = u;
  }
  const n: number = q;
  return 'n' + n;
}

function partial(u: 'a' | 'b' | 'c'): string {
  switch (u) {
    case 'a':
      return 'A';
    case 'b':
      return 'B';
  }
}

console.log(withBreak('a'), objectWithBreak({ kind: 'square', side: 1 }), withDefault('a'));
console.log(neverMember('a'), assignedAfter('a'), mergedAfter('a', 1), partial('a'));
